en: A black‑and‑white (or sepia‑toned) vintage street scene showing a wide, straight avenue lined with multi‑story residential townhouses on both sides. The buildings have late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European architectural features, such as gabled roofs, dormer windows, and decorative facades. Wrought‑iron fences and small front gardens line the sidewalks. Two men walk down the middle of the quiet street, while a woman and child stand near a gate on the left side. Printed in red at the top are the words 'Geringswalde.' on the left and 'Goldammer Straße.' on the right.
